meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 16 (DECISIONS 038, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new Anker models, 10 quotes, 0 identifiers verified (all 5 stay pending — see catalog notes). Anker US homepage sweep 2026-11-06 (24 shelf listings, 23 distinct models; BUILD_LOG 054): the 5 added are the MagGo 2 Pro Magnetic Power Bank (10K, Qi2 25W, Active Cooling, A110R, Phantom Gray), Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W, A110A, Black), Desktop USB-C Hub (A210C), Prime Wireless Car Charger (MagGo, AirCool, Pad, A2933) and Nano Charger (70W, 3 Ports, B121A, Black Stone). The Nano Charger (45W, Smart Display, 180-degree Foldable, A121D) was NOT added: two different US product pages ($34.99 PreOrder on the dual-foldable page vs $39.99 InStock on the foldable-plug-compact page) and the page text never states which Shopify variant is which color, so no color can be pinned cleanly — the Nano 70W replaces it as this batch's charger pick. Soundcore earbuds/speakers are not listed on anker.com (separate soundcore.com store) and were not picked, per the 'only what the official US catalog actually lists as current' rule. SALE vs LIST: Anker direct A110A is $199.99 on sale ($30 off the $229.99 list — homepage shelf + '$30 OFF' banner; product-page JSON-LD and the Meta feed both show $229.99); Anker direct A210C is $79.99 on sale ($20 off the $99.99 list — homepage shelf + Anker blog '$20 OFF, $79.99, Code: WSPDV2ONVYED'; JSON-LD and the feed both show $99.99). STALE FEED PRICE: the anker.com feed row for the A2933 car charger says $135, but the live page JSON-LD and the us.anker.com feed row both say $89.99 — the $135 row was excluded. No Amazon touch: no Amazon quotes, no Amazon-sourced identifiers (the B121A Black UPC 194644241247 appears on Amazon listings only and was not recorded; the A210C UPC 194644340506 appears only on pickoryx, which mirrors the Amazon ASIN listing, and was not recorded). Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{anker-maggo-2-pro,anker-prime-power-bank-26k-300w,anker-desktop-usb-c-hub,anker-prime-wireless-car-charger,anker-nano-charger-70w}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored).
